annotation.annotation_method: Assistant visual review of all clip contact sheets and right-side strips before predictions. Approximate visible head reference centers, not exact full-body boxes. Row checked against body/water lane. No second annotator.
annotation.scope: Visible headed entities only. Headless bodies, detached heads and corpses are negative examples. Occluded entities without a separately visible head are not exhaustively labeled; empty candidates never imply a clear lane. Helmet centers approximate head reference. Identity null in crowded or uncertain cases.
annotation.known_scene_defect_reuse: 470s reward was already a diagnosed Day05 failure and is explicitly development data here. Later reward frames are same-event regression, not independent validation.
